definitions.explanation: Describes a sound that is unpleasantly sharp and high in pitch. Used for voices, screams, laughter, and other sounds that stand out because of their sharp, piercing quality.

examples.japanese: {甲高|かんだか}い⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえた→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧。
{子|こ}どもたち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{甲高|かんだか}い⟦{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}→笑い声：24414_waraigoe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{響|ひび}いていた→響く：00099_hibiku⟧。
examples.english: The children's shrill laughter echoed through the park.

examples.japanese: ⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{甲高|かんだか}い⟦{悲鳴|ひめい}→悲鳴：12621_himei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{聞|き}こえて→聞こえる：01229_kikoeru⟧きた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{慌|あわ}てて→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧⟦{様子|ようす}→様子：01521_yousu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I heard a piercing scream from the next room, so I rushed to check what was going on.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used to describe sounds, especially voices and screams. Carries a slightly negative connotation — the sound is not just high, but piercingly so.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {甲高|かんだか}く
- Noun form: not commonly used

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {甲高|かんだか}い⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧ (shrill voice)
- {甲高|かんだか}い⟦{笑|わら}い{声|ごえ}→笑い声：24414_waraigoe⟧ (shrill laughter)
- {甲高|かんだか}い⟦{悲鳴|ひめい}→悲鳴：12621_himei⟧ (piercing scream)
- {甲高|かんだか}く⟦{叫|さけ}ぶ→叫ぶ：02108_sakebu⟧ (to scream shrilly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: high (general — pitch, height, price; neutral in tone)
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: sharp, keen (describes quality of sound or sensation, not specifically pitch)
- ⟦{耳障|みみざわ}り→耳障り：20216_mimizawari⟧: grating, unpleasant to the ear (focuses on the listener's discomfort)
